subject_evidence.quote: Implementation of ISO 9001 Certification for field offices of EPFO —

evidence.quote: Headquarters letter dated 09.11.2012 at serial no. 411 on the EPFO website

relationships.scope: The 28 March 2013 reminder refers to the 9 November 2012 Headquarters letter on implementing ISO 9001 in all field offices and repeats it; it does not change it. Later reminders (June 2013, August 2013, January 2015) cite the same letter.

limitations: This collection holds two small sets: Headquarters circulars on ISO 9001 certification of field offices (a letter of 9 November 2012 and four reminders to January 2015) and Vigilance circulars on complaints (PIDPI procedure of 2012, lodging of complaints of 2014 and streamlining the investigation mechanism of December 2014). Public grievance (CPGRAMS, EPFiGMS) circulars are not included.
No circular here states that ISO 9001 certification was completed, withdrawn or dropped; the last circular found is the January 2015 reminder, so the status is not recorded.
The 2012 Public Interest Disclosure circular forwards the Central Vigilance Commission's instructions on how complainants must file whistle-blower complaints; the Resolution itself is not reproduced.

The 2014 lodging-of-complaints circular directs offices to ask complainants for mobile numbers and e-mail IDs, with no commencement date; only the December 2014 investigation-mechanism circular states 'with immediate effect', which is recorded.
The fraud-complaint circular of 2013 mentioned in the Vigilance catalog is not in the issuer's circulars table and is not included.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
